facts.text: Does the jeweled chalice (worth 600 gold) that Trout took from Sir Brandon's tomb belong to the church, as Brother Dirk suggests? Trout put off the question, saying they would figure it out later.

Are the robes of Saint Arthur magical? Brother Dirk says they are far too holy to wear and objects to Dr. Uriah wearing them. Dr. Uriah could not test them without Ingrid's witch powder, and wearing them had no notable effect.
